properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own TripleDES: implementation in src/tripledes.js, shipped as C.TripleDES (build/component entry in grunt/config/modularize.js, export "CryptoJS.TripleDES" in package.json), exercised by the library's known-answer test suite (test/tripledes-test.js, including ECB-mode vectors). 3DES is legacy — 64-bit block (Sweet32) and 112-bit effective security; not Shor-vulnerable (symmetric) but below modern strength. Changeable here: this project's own shipped code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own RC4 stream cipher: implementation in src/rc4.js, shipped as C.RC4 / C.RC4Drop (build entries in grunt/config/modularize.js:114-116 and package.json:49), exercised by known-answer tests in test/rc4-test.js. RC4 is classically broken (Keystream bias, Fluhrer-Mantin-Shamir); the shipped library exposes it to every downstream consumer. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own MD5: implementation in src/md5.js, exported as C.MD5 (and HmacMD5), exercised by the library's known-answer test suite (test/md5-test.js) and profiler (test/md5-profile.js). MD5 is collision-broken classically; the shipped library exposes it to all downstream consumers. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own HmacMD5: helper factory at src/md5.js:247 (C.HmacMD5 = Hasher._createHmacHelper(MD5)), export entry in grunt/config/modularize.js:61, exercised by RFC 2202 known-answer vectors in test/hmac-md5-test.js. HMAC keyed construction retains ~128-bit MAC strength (not collision-broken like bare MD5), symmetric MAC so not Shor-critical; still quantum-halved by Grover and tied to a broken hash. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECB mode-of-operation asset: test/mode-ecb-test.js:5 names the mode the test exercises (name: 'ECB'); the shipped implementation is src/mode-ecb.js, registered in cipher-core.js and selectable via { mode: C.mode.ECB } on every block cipher the library ships (test/tripledes-test.js:70-71 uses it). ECB leaks plaintext patterns and is deterministic — a genuine mode weakness the library exposes. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 invocations with low iteration counts in the library's own test suite and profilers: RFC 6070 known-answer vectors (iterations: 1, 2, 4096) and profiling loops (iterations: 20). Intentionally weak parameters for vector-verification/perf-timing — real crypto, but the values do not ship as library defaults. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: A CMAC (OMAC1) implementation written inside the library's own test suite: test/cipher-test.js:388 defines C.algo.CMAC over Base and wires C.CMAC/OMAC1/OMAC2, used at :494-519 to verify AES-CMAC known-answer vectors. It is test-only code (not exported by the shipped library index), but real cryptography in the repository — a MAC derived from AES. Symmetric MAC, not Shor-vulnerable; Grover halves the tag strength at most. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own HmacSHA1: helper factory at src/sha1.js:129 (C.HmacSHA1 = Hasher._createHmacHelper(SHA1)), export entry grunt/config/modularize.js:65, exercised by RFC 2202 vectors in test/sha1-test.js:67 (C.algo.HMAC.create(C.algo.SHA1, ...)). HMAC over SHA-1 retains ~160-bit MAC strength classically; tied to a collision-broken hash and halved by Grover. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own HmacSHA256/384/512 family: helper factories at src/sha256.js:178, src/sha384.js:62, src/sha512.js:305 (also HmacSHA224 at src/sha224.js), export entries in grunt/config/modularize.js:69-81, exercised by RFC 4231 known-answer vectors across test/hmac-sha*-test.js. Strong MACs (Grover-halved tag strength only, not Shor-vulnerable). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.2.0's own SHA-512 and SHA-384: implementations src/sha512.js:70 and src/sha384.js:13, exercised by known-answer vectors and profilers in test/sha512-test.js, test/sha384-test.js and profiles.
